if(CAMERA_TYPE_INT EQUAL 0)
    set(OB_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_PCL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_OPEN3D_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_BUILD_MAIN_PROJECT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_INSTALL_EXAMPLES_SOURCE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OB_INSTALL_FILTER_DEV_HEADERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(OrbbecSDK_v2)
endif()
